metadata.title: Golden Hour Portrait with Modern Serif

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate close-up of a woman with voluminous, wavy blonde hair. The lighting is warm and hazy, creating a soft glow on the skin and hair, while the eyes remain sharp and expressive. The composition is anchored by a bold, black serif title bar at the very top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm, golden skin tones against a cool, desaturated background
Soft, diffused hair texture contrasting with sharp, heavy typography
Direct eye contact creating a focal point in the center-left of the frame
coreInvariants: Tight cropping on the face and hair
High-contrast black text on a light background area

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is positioned slightly off-center, filling approximately 60% of the frame, surrounded by expansive hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes serve as the primary emotional anchor, while the top-aligned text provides a structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold text at the top, moves down through the waves of hair to the eyes, and then follows the jawline to the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with hair and facial features, with small pockets of hazy background light.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm gold and honey tones in the hair and skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the typography and eye makeup.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft, cool whites and pale blues in the hazy background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) overall with selective high saturation in the warm tones; low value only in the text and pupils.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid harsh greens or neon colors

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Flat, unbracketed or lightly bracketed serifs

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the brightest part of the background/hair at the top

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both artist and title, separated by horizontal space.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and vertical stress of the original.
Provides the necessary weight and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a woman with voluminous wavy blonde hair, warm golden lighting, soft focus background, and sharp eyes with dark makeup.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of bold, black, high-contrast serif text in all-caps across the very top edge of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the text solid black and perfectly horizontal?
Is the lighting warm and hazy without losing detail in the eyes?
Is the hair the primary textural element of the composition?

postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic legibility against the hair
Ensure the eyes are the sharpest point of the image
Verify the top-aligned placement of the text
Confirm the absence of any artifacts in the hair texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key, warm-toned intimate portrait with a top-aligned, high-contrast Didone serif header for a classic editorial look.
